say:8:1821208006:1.male: No idea. Haven't seen him... Maybe he's in the washroom.
say:8:1821208006:1.female: No idea. Haven't seen him... Maybe he's in the washroom.

say:9:1821208007:1.text: ... The lack of sunlight really is getting to you! Torry's a Graveborn. He has no reason to use a washroom.
say:9:1821208007:1.source_cn: ……我看你是真的有点神经错乱了。特里是亡灵，又不是生者...

say:11:1821208009:1.female: There he is. <style="highlight">That stout man with the attitude is the manager, Edward</style>. Torry's the unfortunate soul standing beside him.

say:0:1821209001:0.text: Time to ask him about the Refinery.
say:0:1821209001:0.source_cn: 总算找到特里了，赶紧去问问吧。
say:0:1821209001:0.male: Time to ask him about the Refinery.
say:0:1821209001:0.female: Time to ask him about the Refinery.

say:1:1821211001:1.text: Read the surveillance report yourself! Bantus has already repaired the Soul Forge. It only took them a few days!
say:1:1821211001:1.source_cn: 你自己看看这份监视报告——亡灵转化器已经被班题斯修好了...

say:2:1821211002:1.text: Her Ladyship wanted those repairs delayed by any means necessary. Instead, you stood by and let Bantus finish the job before we could do anything!
say:2:1821211002:1.source_cn: 领主阁下是怎么交代的？绝对不能让班题斯自行修理好转化器...

say:3:1821211003:1.text: Once Her Ladyship hears about this, both our heads will roll!
say:3:1821211003:1.source_cn: 等着看吧……等领主阁下知道，我们就一起完蛋！

say:4:1821211004:1.text: M-Manager... we don't have to take this lying down. Her Ladyship doesn't speak for all of the Syndicate. We could report her to the higher-ups.
say:4:1821211004:1.source_cn: 经、经理……其实没必要这么紧张，领主阁下的命令不能代表...

say:5:1821211005:1.text: Once she's stripped of the title of Sloth, we could—
say:5:1821211005:1.source_cn: 只要她没了“懒惰”的头衔，我们——

say:6:1821211006:1.text: You fool! I trusted you with one of our most important projects, and this is the thanks I get?!
say:6:1821211006:1.source_cn: ——你这个蠢货！亏我这么重视你，把炼化间这么重要的项目...

say:7:1821211007:1.text: You know what I like most about Her Ladyship? She's lazier than every Sloth before her, which means she expects a lot less from us. Without her, we'd never have it this easy!
say:7:1821211007:1.source_cn: 领主阁下最大的好处是什么？是她比历任“懒惰”都更懒，对...

say:9:1821211009:0.text: You've clearly never seen the other branches. Besides, you Graveborn don't need food or sleep. If you're still falling behind, perhaps the problem is you.
say:9:1821211009:0.source_cn: 已经比其他分部好得多了。谁让你们这些亡灵都不用吃饭不用...

say:10:1821211010:0.text: And even if a new Sloth takes over, this branch isn't going anywhere. Do you honestly think Her Ladyship would forgive us for having her removed?
say:10:1821211010:0.source_cn: 再说了，即使“懒惰”换人，诺珐斯分部大概率也不会撤销，...

say:11:1821211011:0.text: Keep your head down and stop suggesting plans that would make life worse for everyone!
say:11:1821211011:0.source_cn: 老实待着，别老想那些损人不利己的点子！

say:12:1821211012:0.text:
—<shk>Gah!</shk>
W-Who are you? How long have you been standing there?!
say:12:1821211012:0.male:
—<shk>Gah!</shk>
W-Who are you? How long have you been standing there?!
say:12:1821211012:0.female:
—<shk>Gah!</shk>
W-Who are you? How long have you been standing there?!

say:13:1821211013:0.source_cn: 咳！作为诺珐斯分部的经理，我可要警告你：刚才听到的话一...
say:13:1821211013:0.male: Ahem! As manager of the Novaris branch, I must insist that this conversation remain strictly confidential!
say:13:1821211013:0.female: Ahem! As manager of the Novaris branch, I must insist that this conversation remain strictly confidential!

choice_prompt:14:1821211013.male: Ahem! As manager of the Novaris branch, I must insist that this conversation remain strictly confidential!
choice_prompt:14:1821211013.female: Ahem! As manager of the Novaris branch, I must insist that this conversation remain strictly confidential!

say:15:1821211014:1.text: Is that a threat? Perhaps I should—
say:15:1821211014:1.male: Is that a threat? Perhaps I should—
say:15:1821211014:1.female: Is that a threat? Perhaps I should—

say:16:1821211015:2.text: Without a word, you hold up Tephesia's access crystal. Edward falls silent immediately, his smug expression frozen in place.
say:16:1821211015:2.source_cn: 你默默地拿出了苔佩希的通行水晶。爱德华瞬间噤声，脸上趾...
say:16:1821211015:2.male: Without a word, you hold up Tephesia's access crystal. Edward falls silent immediately, his smug expression frozen in place.
say:16:1821211015:2.female: Without a word, you hold up Tephesia's access crystal. Edward falls silent immediately, his smug expression frozen in place.

say:18:1821211016:2.text: In the very next moment, he puts on his most flattering smile.
say:18:1821211016:2.source_cn: 然而下一秒钟，他就立刻换上了一副巴结谄媚的嘴脸。
say:18:1821211016:2.male: In the very next moment, he puts on his most flattering smile.
say:18:1821211016:2.female: In the very next moment, he puts on his most flattering smile.

say:19:1821211017:1.text: Y-You're here on Her Ladyship's business! Of course you are. I could tell at a glance that you were someone important!
say:19:1821211017:1.source_cn: 原、原来您是来替领主阁下跑腿的啊……难怪您看起来如此器...
say:19:1821211017:1.male: Y-You're here on Her Ladyship's business! Of course you are. I could tell at a glance that you were someone important!
say:19:1821211017:1.female: Y-You're here on Her Ladyship's business! Of course you are. I could tell at a glance that you were someone important!

say:20:1821211018:1.text: So... how may we assist you today?
say:20:1821211018:1.source_cn: 不知……不知您这次前来是所为何事……？
say:20:1821211018:1.male: So... how may we assist you today?
say:20:1821211018:1.female: So... how may we assist you today?

choice_prompt:21:1821211018.text: So... how may we assist you today?
choice_prompt:21:1821211018.source_cn: 不知……不知您这次前来是所为何事……？
choice_prompt:21:1821211018.male: So... how may we assist you today?
choice_prompt:21:1821211018.female: So... how may we assist you today?

say:23:1821211020:1.text: We were only guessing what she wanted... Her Ladyship never gave us a direct order. Absolutely not.
say:23:1821211020:1.source_cn: 这……这是我们的猜测。领主阁下没有明确下达过这样的命令...
say:23:1821211020:1.male: We were only guessing what she wanted... Her Ladyship never gave us a direct order. Absolutely not.
say:23:1821211020:1.female: We were only guessing what she wanted... Her Ladyship never gave us a direct order. Absolutely not.

say:24:1821211021:1.text: E-Exactly! Lady Sloth is one of the seven elders. She would never act against the Syndicate's interests. The very idea is absurd! Ha... ha...
say:24:1821211021:1.source_cn: 对，对，领主阁下怎么可能下这样的命令？她可是七长老之一...
say:24:1821211021:1.male: E-Exactly! Lady Sloth is one of the seven elders. She would never act against the Syndicate's interests. The very idea is absurd! Ha... ha...
say:24:1821211021:1.female: E-Exactly! Lady Sloth is one of the seven elders. She would never act against the Syndicate's interests. The very idea is absurd! Ha... ha...

say:25:1821211022:1.text: We only did it because she—because we can't stand those Bantus Graveborn. Slowing them down was entirely our own idea.
say:25:1821211022:1.source_cn: 我们只不过是见她……呸，只不过是看班题斯那些亡灵不顺眼...
say:25:1821211022:1.male: We only did it because she—because we can't stand those Bantus Graveborn. Slowing them down was entirely our own idea.
say:25:1821211022:1.female: We only did it because she—because we can't stand those Bantus Graveborn. Slowing them down was entirely our own idea.

say:28:1821211024:0.text: Edward keeps wiping the sweat from his brow. Torry looks just as nervous and refuses to meet your eyes.
say:28:1821211024:0.source_cn: 爱德华不断擦拭着额头上渗出的冷汗，特里也一脸心虚，不敢...
say:28:1821211024:0.male: Edward keeps wiping the sweat from his brow. Torry looks just as nervous and refuses to meet your eyes.
say:28:1821211024:0.female: Edward keeps wiping the sweat from his brow. Torry looks just as nervous and refuses to meet your eyes.

say:29:1821211025:0.text: Both men are clearly terrified that you will repeat everything they said to Tephesia.
say:29:1821211025:0.source_cn: 看得出来，他们非常畏惧苔佩希，生怕你会将他们暗中说的坏...
say:29:1821211025:0.male: Both men are clearly terrified that you will repeat everything they said to Tephesia.
say:29:1821211025:0.female: Both men are clearly terrified that you will repeat everything they said to Tephesia.

choice:21:0:1.text: You said Her Ladyship ordered you to interfere with Bantus?
choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 你们刚才说是领主下令阻碍班题斯？
choice:21:0:1.male: You said Her Ladyship ordered you to interfere with Bantus?
choice:21:0:1.female: You said Her Ladyship ordered you to interfere with Bantus?

say:30:1821211026:1.text: Yes... After the Refinery was attacked, a guard commander from Bantus brought in soldiers and took over the Soul Forge repairs.
say:30:1821211026:1.source_cn: 是的……自从炼化间遇袭后，班题斯那位禁卫大人就率领军队...
say:30:1821211026:1.male: Yes... After the Refinery was attacked, a guard commander from Bantus brought in soldiers and took over the Soul Forge repairs.
say:30:1821211026:1.female: Yes... After the Refinery was attacked, a guard commander from Bantus brought in soldiers and took over the Soul Forge repairs.

say:31:1821211027:0.text: That's the only reason they finished so quickly. N-Not that I'm criticizing Her Ladyship, of course!
say:31:1821211027:0.source_cn: 否则转化器怎么可能这么快就修好……啊，我、我不是在吐槽...
say:31:1821211027:0.male: That's the only reason they finished so quickly. N-Not that I'm criticizing Her Ladyship, of course!
say:31:1821211027:0.female: That's the only reason they finished so quickly. N-Not that I'm criticizing Her Ladyship, of course!

say:32:1821211028:1.text: I'm sure you know Her Ladyship better than we do, sir. She has a habit of waiting until the last possible moment before giving an order.
say:32:1821211028:1.male: I'm sure you know Her Ladyship better than we do, sir. She has a habit of waiting until the last possible moment before giving an order.

document:1:634:0.text:
Project Overview:
Recreate the main function of Bantus' lost Graveborn relic and use a controlled magical ritual to convert the living into Graveborn.

Technical Basis:
Gravecalling draws on <style="highlight">death energy</style>. Converting a living person into Graveborn requires a large and stable supply of it. The Soul Forge creates a temporary field that gathers death energy from the surrounding world, concentrates it, and channels it into the subject.
The lost Graveborn relic worked in much the same way. However, <style="highlight">it already held a large reserve of death energy</style>, so it could perform the conversion more easily.

Soul Forge Design:
Control Room: Used to activate the Soul Forge.
Altar: Where the living subject stands during the conversion.
Protective Barrier: Separates the control room from the altar. If the concentrated death energy reaches nearby Graveborn, it could kill them a second time and erase them completely.

Risk Warning:
<style="highlight">Once the conversion begins, it cannot be stopped.</style> In addition, the <style="highlight">altar is extremely fragile</style> and must be protected throughout the ritual. No effective way to reinforce it has yet been found.
document:1:634:0.source_cn:
项目概论：
复现班题斯遗失之亡灵圣器的核心功能，通过可控的魔法仪式，将生者转化为亡灵。
技术原理分析：
亡灵魔法源于<style="highlight">死亡之力</style>，将生者转化为亡灵之过程需要大量稳定的死亡之力。转化器之核心功能即通过特定魔力脉网，构建一个临时力场，短暂富集并借用世间散落的死亡之力，作用于生者。
其转化原理与亡灵圣器类似，但<style="highlight">亡灵圣器天然保存着强大的死亡之力</style>，使用其转化更为简单便捷。
转化器架构设计：
转化操作间——启动转化器之处。
祭坛——生者所站立之处，转化发生之处。
魔法防护屏障——隔绝操作间与祭坛，避免富集的死亡之力波及周围亡灵，致使亡灵经历二次死亡，彻底消散。
风险预警：
<style="highlight">转化一旦启动便无法停止</style>，且因其<style="highlight">祭坛异常脆弱</style>，仪式过程中务必严防破坏。暂无有效办法加固，有待研究。
